aboutSubheading: Licensed, insured & on call for emergencies
aboutText: Triple M Electrical and Air Conditioning is a Fitzroy North-based business providing the best electrical and air conditioning solutions across Melbourne. We understand that emergency breakdowns and new installations have urgency, which is why our team is ready to respond quickly. With an extensive portfolio working with dentists, medical centres, cafés, and factories, there is nothing too big or too small for our skilled electricians.
servicesText: From emergency breakdowns and preventative maintenance to new installations and energy-saving upgrades, our licensed team handles all electrical and air conditioning needs for residential, commercial, and industrial properties.

services.title: Emergency Breakdowns & Fault Finding
services.desc: We respond urgently to restore power outages, address electrical hazards, and perform general fault finding to get your property back online safely.

services.title: Indoor & Outdoor Lighting
services.desc: Specialists in all types of lighting, including LED upgrades, exit & emergency lighting, and automated sensor systems for enhanced security and efficiency.

services.title: Switchboards & Cabling
services.desc: Installation and upgrades of basic and major switchboards, 415V three-phase cabling, and mains cabling for safe, reliable power distribution.

services.title: C-Bus & Home Automation
services.desc: Expert installation of C-Bus systems and smart home automation to give you convenient control over your lighting, security, and climate.

services.title: Air Conditioning Solutions
services.desc: Professional installation, servicing, and repairs for heating and cooling systems to maintain perfect comfort in your home or business all year round.

services.title: Preventative Maintenance
services.desc: Scheduled site maintenance, wiring checks, and energy-saving assessments designed to prevent costly breakdowns and improve your property's safety.
